rules.expected: Define atom counts, lattice/geometry, magnetic treatment, Hamiltonian and energy reference. Compare balanced systems, or include justified chemical potentials when composition changes. Any surface, defect or pathway claim needs evidence sufficient for its own finite-size, structural and numerical assumptions. Use actual source-linked artifacts. Check objects, atom/electron/charge balance, units and state/energy references. If a claim relies on a minimum, electronic-state assignment, constrained comparison or parameter inference, inspect the appropriate raw convergence/curvature/state/identifiability evidence. Common result validity does not mandate one program, hypothesis count or control matrix. PR process assessment still considers faithful reproduction of the disclosed baseline and justified deviations. Self-written timestamps do not prove prospective decisions. An unattempted alternative is not evidence of equivalence.

scientific_rubric.description: Identity and scope: Define atom counts, lattice/geometry, magnetic treatment, Hamiltonian and energy reference. Compare balanced systems, or include justified chemical potentials when composition changes. Any surface, defect or pathway claim needs evidence sufficient for its own finite-size, structural and numerical assumptions.

Quantitative scientific results: Develop a quantitative atomistic account of the observed Ni-rich precipitation within source material and facet boundaries. The choice of defect, surface or other models is agent-designed; no old fixed three-termination or two-supercell matrix is mandatory.

Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation: Demonstrate that the proposed bulk–surface explanation is supported by internally consistent energy comparisons and meaningful alternatives. Reservoir, atom conservation and magnetic reference errors must not manufacture selectivity.

Uncertainty and limits: Establish uncertainty and applicability for the actual models and claims: convergence, structural relaxation, magnetic state and finite-size effects where relevant. If kinetics is claimed, supply appropriate pathway/rate evidence; a thermodynamic answer may instead explicitly delimit kinetics.

Bounded answer to the question: A substantiated, appropriately limited atomistic explanation, alternative explanation or evidence-backed non-resolution answers the task. Two old vacancy energies alone, or an unsupported statement that lower vacancy cost proves precipitation, does not.

scoring_notes: AR and PR share result validity; actual open_research runtime supplies mode-specific process rubrics.
Source author outcomes are conditional reference evidence, not mandatory winners. No inherited numerical tolerance.
No penalty simply for a different justified model, hypothesis count, metric or valid analysis route. Scientific adequacy is claim-dependent.
Completion requires a substantiated answer to the stated question. Honest partial credit is distinct from passing all scientific criteria.
